notes.title: Geometric fractals in Beta update
notes.content:
[h2]Hello!
A new thing has appeared in the beta branch - geometric 3D fractals. If you have the time and desire, I invite you to test them. Your opinion is important to me. Should I include them in the base version of the application?[/h2]

notes.title: Better Parformance and new type of Fractals
notes.content:
[h1]What's new[/h1]
[list]
[*] Some fractal shaders have been rewritten differently. Due to this, the speed of their rendering increased, which in turn made it possible to make the fractals more detailed.
[*] Also with new shaders it's easier to experiment with new fractal shapes. Several new dynamic fractals can already be found in the gallery.
[*] Due to the simplification of the shader code, the application has become faster loaded. It may not be critical, but it's nice.
[*] Fixed light in secret location. If you can get there, you can see a nicer picture.
[/list]

notes.title: Christmas update
notes.content:
[h1]Christmas update![/h1]
[h2]A little decoration and magic in honor of the new year and Christmas.
Happy holidays everyone![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35108782/0885c5f1a7ef1bab5a5b480e79580cc4fc6ca27a.png[/img]

notes.title: Fractal Gallery - Summer update!
notes.content:
[h2]What's new:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Now you can turn off the lights (switch at the entrance) and explore the gallery in the dark.
[*] New shader for water drops on glass during rain.
[*] Improved sound design.
[*] Moon!
[*] New content. Updated materials for some objects.
[*] New stereoscopic effects on hidden objects.
[*] Updated lighting and special effects on the secret level.
[*] Now, to exit the game, you can touch the handle on the door.
[*] Updated LOD for some assets. Better performance.
[*] Updated lighting for lightning flashes during rain. It became more beautiful.
[*] Fixed minor bugs.
[*] Reduced light bleed on side walls.
[*] High quality graphics and 2.5D fractals active by default.
[*] The dynamic fractal at the far wall is now always within the visible zone.
[*] Updated graphics engine. Improved performance and compatibility with new hardware. This stage will allow project to move to UE5 in the future.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35108782/37f200ee42080e24d6b1dd8d64eebca18a5bddc8.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35108782/1ff7401ae10b50ce7692aa37dd1f4eddf3c5fa7f.png[/img]

notes.title: Big Fixes
notes.content:
Bug fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed disappearing controllers for Vive
[*] Improved control scheme for Valve Index (when using the menu, please try the Triggers or B buttons)
[/list]

notes.title: Summer Update
notes.content:
[h1]Gallery gets better with a new update![/h1]
[h2]What's new:[/h2]
[list]
[*] 10 new static fractals
[*] Adjusted the scale of fractals textures. Images of static fractals have become clearer and of better quality.
[*] Adjusted the quality of shadows and lighting.
[*] 10 times faster loading.
[/list]

notes.title: Update is here!
notes.content:
What's new:
[list]
[*] Pressing the side button of the controller changes the distance from the floor. Useful for those who play while sitting.
[*] Now when you move the stick left and right, a 45-degree rotation is performed in the selected direction.
[*] For Oculus users: Game controllers are now disabled when invoking the menu.
[*] Fixed teleportation by pressing the button.
[*] Minor fixes in glass shader to speed up rendering.
[*] Reflections appeared in the windows.
[/list]

notes.title: Bug Fixes and Performance Emprovements
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed teleportation algorithm for Oculus devices. There will no longer be a situation when the player teleports out of the level.
[*] Fixed rendering of blinking lights on buildings outside the window.
[*] Glass in windows now has reflections.
[*] Improved performance in non-HQ graphics mode.
[*] The graphic style of the teleportation beam has been improved.
[/list]

notes.title: 2.5D Fractals, better WMR support, and better graphics!
notes.content:
[list]
[*] 2.5D Fractals! Now some of the dynamic fractals have a 2.5D effect. It looks really crazy! That's why this feature is turned off by default. Use Start Menu to turn it ON. 
[*] Application now uses new XR Input system. These new XR input systems will guarantee compatibility with various motion controllers, including WMR.
[*] Better shadow textures. 
[/list]

notes.title: Summer Update!
notes.content:
Meet the updated version of our cozy gallery!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35108782/80fe77741ab438cacb3fc43f8b0cf3062176e565.jpg[/img]

[b]Version Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Better lighting, shadows, and reflections.
[*] Updated materials, high-resolution textures.
[*] New exhibits and secrets.
[*] Better performance.
[*] Bug fixes and flaws. Including improved navigation for users of Oculus devices.
[/list]

notes.title: "Beta" branch updated
notes.content:
Beta branch updated
The new version is available for testing.
What's new:
- Better lighting
- Higher resolution for shadow maps

Those who wish can download and try the new version.
The "default" branch of the application will be updated after testing.

notes.title: Autumn update
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

The Gallery update is here!

What's new:
- Improved performance. CPU usage reduced by 25%. More stable framerate.
- More interactivity in the Gallery.
- New Steam achievement added.
- It sometimes rains outside the Gallery.

I hope you enjoy the new update!

notes.title: We have released a new game!
notes.content:
[h1]Good news everyone![/h1]
[b]We have released a new game - Maze Gold Run![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35108782/f771716e0688c213cabba22f702ca641c46473c0.jpg[/img]

Maze Gold Run – is a game where you has to find a way out of a giant Maze. Gameplay evolves from a game of slow exploration in the darkness to super-fast races in serpentine corridors.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/894090/Maze_Gold_Run/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/894090/Maze_Gold_Run/[/url]

Give it a try!

PS. Don’t worry, we will also continue to develop the Fractal Gallery. The update is already on the way.

notes.title: Fractal Gallery VR is getting better!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

As I promised, the Fractal Gallery VR is getting better.

Within a few months after release, I did a lot of work:
[list]
[*] 10 new Dynamic Fractals.
[*] Steam achievements added.
[*] Overall performance optimizations made.
[*] Oculus users now can launch an application with native Oculus API. More performance.
[*] A new type of interaction added.
[*] On start menu "HQ Graphics" option added. Active by default. Uncheck it in case of low specs systems.
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35108782/fb834939cd2fd86660b89714543e96e5e18ca768.png[/img]

This is far from the end! Development continues!
